6'' AMOLED Dual Screen Gaming Handheld ... (Bottom Screen)

notes: REFERENCE DEVICE, and the registry's worst-sourced entry. AYN publishes NO dimensions and NO mass on any page of its own site. Verified exhaustively: the product page body_html (extracted from the page's embedded Shopify product JSON) states only SoC/RAM/storage tiers, the two display diagonals, Android 13, 6000mAh, Hall sticks and warranty; ayntec.com has no Thor spec/landing page (checked sitemap_pages_1.xml - only Loki/Odin pages exist) and no Thor blog posts (sitemap_blogs_1.xml); the Thor TPU shell and carrying-case accessory pages state no dimensions either. The domain ayn.tech named in the request does not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND) - AYN's official store is ayntec.com. TRAP: the product page's cart JSON contains "weight":800 for every variant - that is the Shopify SHIPPING weight of the boxed product, NOT the device mass, and must not be used as mass_g. SECONDARY-ONLY (left null here, listed so a human can decide): review/aggregator sites (hothardware.com, droix.net, retrocatalog.com, retrospecgame.com) consistently state ~150 x 94 x 25.6 mm (5.9 x 3.7 x 1 in) and ~380 g, top screen 1080x1920 @120Hz 650 nits, bottom screen 1080x1240 @60Hz 550 nits, and ports USB 3.1 Type-C / 3.5mm / microSD with DisplayPort Alt Mode. None of that appears on ayntec.com. AYN states "Full HD" for the 6in panel, which conventionally denotes 1920x1080, but prints no pixel count, so resolution_px is left null rather than inferred. hinge.type=clamshell and hinge.axis=long are read from AYN's own "Dual Screen ... (Bottom Screen)" description of a top-over-bottom folding handheld, not from any published hinge statement; no angle, free-stop or crease figure is published anywhere by AYN.
